errors.text_span: в сферата на храните и напитките
errors.evidence: The description adds context ('in the food and beverage industry') that is not present in the figure itself. The figure's title is general and does not specify an industry.
The chart is a pie chart ('кръгова диаграма'), not a spiderweb chart ('паяжина').

errors.text_span: което визуално подчертава доминирането на слоганите с реторични фигури
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence interprets the visual effect of the chart ('which visually emphasizes the dominance...') rather than just describing the data. A factual description should state that one slice is much larger than the other, without interpreting the designer's intent.
